resolution_rule: No resolution search unless pilot proxy localization is weak and peak VRAM <3 GiB; any such addition requires a logged amendment before testing.
final_epoch_rule: Rounded median best epoch over the four predeclared development categories, clipped to [3,8]; fresh final models use all fitting normals and this fixed duration.
selection_rule: Highest macro synthetic-probe recall at official-normal-development 95th-percentile image threshold; tie-break by probe pixel AP then lower parameter count. No calibration/test access.
proxy_generator: Fixed mixed generator with seed 9901, independent of each candidate's training generator; only held-out fitting normals and donors.
